nodes.label: Template Method Pattern
nodes.rationale: Chosen to eliminate ~200 lines of duplicated analysis code per engine: all common UCI protocol handling, process management, timeout handling and stream buffering live once in BaseChessEngine.analyze(), while subclasses override only hooks (sendEngineOptions, sendAnalysisCommand, getDefaultDepth, getDefaultTimeoutMs). Abstract methods were preferred over virtual defaults because every engine must define how to set options and send analysis commands; this shrank each engine from ~200 to ~30 lines (85% reduction) and means analysis bugs are fixed in one place.

nodes.label: BaseChessEngine
nodes.rationale: Abstract base class holding all engine-common logic (analyze() UCI protocol loop, start/stop process management, onLog logging, sendCommand piping) so concrete engines only implement template-method hooks. Exists to guarantee zero duplication between StockfishEngine and LC0Engine and to make adding a new engine a matter of implementing ~5 methods.

nodes.label: UCI Protocol Handling
nodes.rationale: Universal Chess Interface commands (ucinewgame, setoption, position fen, go depth, info/bestmove output) are the shared communication contract with both Stockfish and LC0; centralizing its handling is the core motivation for the base class and shared parser.

nodes.label: IChessEngine
nodes.rationale: Engine-agnostic interface (name, capabilities, isRunning, start, stop, analyze, onLog) that defines what all engines must do with no implementation details, so the compiler enforces consistency and main-process code needs no stockfish-vs-lc0 conditionals.

nodes.label: StockfishEngine
nodes.rationale: Concrete engine: CP score parsing (no WDL), mate detection, Multi-PV support, 30-second default timeout, default depth 20. Reduced to ~30 lines by extending BaseChessEngine and overriding only the template hooks.

nodes.label: LC0Engine
nodes.rationale: Concrete engine: WDL (win probability) score parsing, GPU backend management (CUDA, DirectML, Metal, CPU), Multi-PV support, 60-second default timeout because neural-network analysis is slower than Stockfish.

nodes.label: EngineFactory
nodes.rationale: Factory for dependency injection: createEngine(name, detectionResult) returns a concrete engine typed as IChessEngine, and getAvailableEngines lists detected engines with fallback logic preferring Stockfish. Reverses the dependency flow from 'main.ts -> engine' to 'main.ts <- factory <- engine'.

nodes.label: Dependency Injection
nodes.rationale: Design principle behind EngineFactory: main code receives engines rather than constructing engine-specific classes, so ProcessManager stays engine-agnostic, engines are testable standalone, and adding an engine never requires modifying main.ts.

nodes.label: ChessLineParser
nodes.rationale: Shared UCI-output parsing utility (parseInfoLine, isInfoLine, isBestmoveLine, extractBestMove) extracted from _analyzeInternal so parsing is isolated business logic with no stream/timing dependencies: testable, reusable by all engines, and extensible to new score formats (CP, mate, WDL) without touching stream code.

nodes.label: ProcessManager
nodes.rationale: main.ts class owning engine lifecycle. Refactor target: replace Record<string, EngineRunner> with Map<string, IChessEngine> populated via EngineFactory from a detection result, add selectEngine(), and route analyze()/shutdown()/initializeFromSettings() through the IChessEngine interface so it is decoupled from any concrete engine.

nodes.label: EngineDetectionResult
nodes.rationale: Detection data (per-engine path, version, GPU backend) produced by engine detection at app startup and passed into ProcessManager and EngineFactory.createEngine; detection must run before ProcessManager initialization.

nodes.label: EngineRunner (legacy)
nodes.rationale: Old monolithic class in main.ts (lines 294-825, 500+ lines) mixing Stockfish and LC0 logic with hard-coded engine-name conditionals inside _analyzeInternal(). Slated for deletion; completely replaced by BaseChessEngine plus the concrete engine classes.

nodes.label: New Engine Architecture Integration Gap
nodes.rationale: Key finding: the new engine architecture (IChessEngine, BaseChessEngine, StockfishEngine, LC0Engine, EngineFactory, ChessLineParser) is 100% ready but never instantiated; ProcessManager.analyze() still calls the old EngineRunner.analyze() at main.ts line 1162, so the new classes sit unused until ProcessManager is refactored to plug them in.
